configurePresets.name: fast-dev
configurePresets.description: RelWithDebInfo build for iteration: batchlas plus a smoke-test subset.

configurePresets.name: cuda
configurePresets.description: Optional CUDA-enabled build when the environment supports it. BATCHLAS_ALLOW_UNSAFE_ENV is written back OFF here, not merely left out: this preset inherits dev, which turns it ON, and the pre-push gate has to run the arm a release build runs. BATCHLAS_MONOLITHIC_LIBRARY is deliberately NOT set here - see the note in the release preset. A monolithic gate would put the 575 s single-threaded device link in front of every pre-push run and every re-run after a one-line fix; the nightly CI job builds the release preset instead, which is where an export regression gets caught without taxing the iteration loop.

configurePresets.name: dev-gpu
configurePresets.description: Fast iteration: drops the native_cpu SYCL target. ~30% off every compile and every device link. GPU coverage ONLY - see dev-tests for the full build.

configurePresets.name: dev-gpu-tests
configurePresets.description: dev-gpu plus tests. Roughly half of every typed suite is not instantiated and ctest still reports green - do not use as a pre-push gate.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: The shipping shape: Release, no tests, no benchmarks, and ONE batchlas shared library. Inherits dev for the same toolchain discovery every other preset gets, then overrides the three things a release differs in. Do not iterate in this tree: the unit of SYCL device linking is the shared library, so ANY one-line edit costs the whole 575 s (9m35s), single-threaded, measured device link of all 15 object libraries. CAP THE PARALLELISM: a from-scratch build of this preset was OOM-killed at --parallel 20 AND at --parallel 8 on a 125 GB box with 115 GB free, both times during compilation rather than the link, which puts a single heavy SYCL translation unit above 14 GB. --parallel 4 completes in 728 s wall. That ceiling is a property of the from-scratch compile, not of the monolithic shape, so it applies to any cold full build here.
